title: 국회의원수당 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text: Article 4 (Standards for Payment of Travel Expenses) Travel expenses paid to members of the National Assembly under Article 14 (1) and (3) of the Act shall be paid according to the standards specified in Appendix 3, applying the Regulations on Travel Expenses of Public Officials mutatis mutandis: Provided, That where the Speaker of the National Assembly deems it necessary to adjust travel expenses before these Rules are amended, the Speaker may determine the adjustment within the scope of the adjustment of travel expenses for public officials.
